description: Composition policy for WFC / modular-tile layouts — dungeon/level layouts, modular city/facade layouts, modular kit assemblies. Pattern: grid-or-graph cell array (primary_volume tagged 'wfc_grid') + per-cell tile selection from a tile-pool with adjacency constraints + post-process boundary trim. Expansions add tile nodes by walking the grid, then add a boundary_trim node when the brief declares trim_style. Tile selection respects the brief's tile_pool reference (resolved by the synthesizer at expansion time). The policy is non-family-keyed; it applies to any asset whose construction graph carries a primary_volume tagged 'wfc_grid' or a part named 'grid' / 'tile_array'.
